ms.promise:
・In the second milestone, we will deliver the comprehensive technical specification for the DAO. This document will provide an in-depth overview of the architecture, functionalities, and interactions of the various smart contracts that will form the foundation of any DAO ecosystem.
・The specification will detail the user-level interactions with the DAO, outlining how participants will engage with its services and governance mechanisms. It will also include a thorough protocol specification, which describes the underlying rules, processes, and operational logic governing the system.
・Additionally, the document will feature a series of flowcharts and state-transition diagrams to visually illustrate the different operational states and transitions.
・This technical specification will serve as a blueprint for the implementation of the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for the DAO. It will act as a guiding reference for the next milestones to the development team.
ms.criteria: This milestone should be accepted given its technical depth will be sufficient enough.

ms.report:
We've completed the DAO smart-contracted that follows the specifications we outlined in previous milestones, and launched it on a Cardano's preview testnet. Not only did we launch this contract, we've created a video showing how it works. We created the DAO smart-contract, then created a proposal on-chain, then created shards, a vote, merging the shards, and ending the proposal.
Link to the video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HTWaSbViASvY2Ub326sWVQOH1s1oJNA8/view?usp=sharing
